signals.thesis: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly kept its policy rate on hold, defying economists' forecasts for an interest-rate hike. The decision sent the New Zealand dollar tumbling, posting its steepest drop against the Australian dollar since 2017.
signals.title: New Zealand dollar tumbles after RBNZ unexpectedly holds policy rate

signals.thesis: Following reports that Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom were eyeing up to $5 billion in Meta's $95 billion offering for AI infrastructure, Nvidia and AMD will invest $4 billion in Meta to deepen their AI partnership.
signals.title: Nvidia and AMD commit $4B to Meta's $95B AI capital raise

signals.thesis: After shelving plans for a U.S. IPO of its Solidigm memory unit amid market volatility last week, SK Hynix reported a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in third-quarter profit on AI hardware demand and unveiled an additional shareholder return program. The earnings beat and capital return announcement sent the South Korean chipmaker's shares soaring over 8%.
signals.title: SK Hynix posts seven-fold profit surge and unveils shareholder return plan

signals.thesis: Following recent FAA approval for its 737 Max 10, Boeing reported a third-quarter loss due to higher commercial-jet costs even as defense sales lifted total revenue 4% to $24.19 billion and 737 production progressed toward 47 jets a month. Shares slid after the plane maker reset investor expectations for free cash flow growth over the coming years.
signals.title: Boeing shares slide on free cash flow reset despite 4% revenue growth

signals.thesis: UPS beat third-quarter earnings and revenue estimates as shipping demand remained strong despite price increases. The courier raised its full-year guidance for a second consecutive quarter in anticipation of a strong holiday shipping season.
signals.title: UPS beats Q3 estimates and raises full-year sales outlook again
